dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250318-MDG-01](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250318-MDG-01) A flood occurred on Mar 18 2025 in Madagascar. It affected an estimated 138403 people and 45057 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
